scenes.title: Choose the file for the job
scenes.narration: This is a synthetic study voice. Choose the file format for the work you need to do. Keep an editable master and a checked reading copy.

scenes.title: DOCX keeps wording editable
scenes.narration: A D O C X document lets you revise words, headings and tables. Use it for an editable notice. Open the saved file and check its contents.

scenes.title: XLSX keeps calculations working
scenes.narration: An X L S X workbook can keep sheets and formulas. Change an input, inspect the formula and check that the total recalculates.

scenes.title: PDF keeps a reading copy
scenes.narration: A P D F is a page based reading copy. Check every page for missing rows or cut off words. Keep the editable source as well.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.narration: A quantity changes. Which file should you update first: the working workbook or its old P D F copy? Pause and explain your choice.

scenes.title: Check your answer
scenes.narration: Update the working workbook. Check the formulas and total, then create and inspect a fresh reading copy. Keep the old version so the change can be traced.
